description: E10 retrieval gold set. Each query names the ONE corpus document (app/rag.py CORPUS title) a clinician would expect to be cited. 'lexical' queries share content words with the document; 'paraphrase' queries were written to share NO content word with the document's title, text or keywords, so they measure what term matching cannot do. Written before any retriever was measured on them.
